description_en: Queries the details of quota dimensions for a specific Alibaba Cloud service
description_zh: 查询目标云产品支持的配额维度详情
name: GetProductQuotaDimension

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service.

For more information, see the `ProductCode` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

If the quota dimension has dependencies, specify both the key and value for each dependent dimension
parameters.help_zh:
目标配额维度的Key。

当目标配额维度有依赖配额维度时，依赖配额维度的Key和Value必须设置，且需要同时设置
parameters.name: dimension_key

fields.help_en:
The key of the dependent quota dimension.

The value of N depends on the number of dependent dimensions.

You must specify both the key and value for a dependent dimension
fields.help_zh:
目标配额维度依赖的配额维度的Key。

N的取值范围取决于目标配额维度依赖的配额维度的个数。
依赖配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the dependent quota dimension.

The value of N depends on the number of dependent dimensions.

You must specify both the key and value for a dependent dimension
fields.help_zh:
目标配额维度依赖的配额维度的Value。

N的取值范围取决于目标配额维度依赖的配额维度的个数。
依赖配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置
fields.name: value

parameters.help_zh: 目标配额维度依赖的配额维度
parameters.name: dependent_dimensions
